status_definitions.FULLY_DEFINED_BY_STANDARD: The standard defines the requirement and the implementation may conform without a new methodological decision.
status_definitions.PARTIALLY_DEFINED_BY_STANDARD: The standard requires the concept or output but does not define the complete numeric calculation.
status_definitions.OWNER_APPROVED: A specific owner-approved governance artifact defines the behavior.
status_definitions.NOT_DEFINED_OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED: The standard does not define the numeric behavior. It must remain inactive until explicitly approved.
status_definitions.NON_METHODOLOGICAL: Operational behavior that does not determine forecast values or investment recommendations.
